hook: AI chatbots do not look anything up.
visual_style: Photorealistic cinematic film still, real materials and textures, shallow depth of field, dark room with glowing cyan and violet light, soft reflections on glass
world: A cozy home desk at night today, and an imagined endless library of light where words come from
through_line: a stream of glowing blank word tiles, guessed one at a time

cast.User: a woman in her 20s with a short black bob, oversized cream sweater, silver hoop earrings

props.Laptop: a slim silver laptop whose screen glows soft blue with blurred unreadable lines
props.Tiles: glowing translucent blue tiles, each a blank rectangle of light with no letters

places.Desk: a cozy desk by a dark window at night, warm lamp, a few plants
places.Library: an endless library of towering bookshelves fading into blue mist

cta: Follow for the next one: three prompts that get better answers.

captions.hook_line: AI chatbots don't look things up. They predict the next word. Here's why that matters 🤖
captions.body: Large language models generate text by predicting likely next tokens from patterns learned in training. That makes them fluent, but they can produce confident errors called hallucinations. Give context and the format you want, and for facts ask for sources you can check.
captions.comment_prompt: What's the strangest thing a chatbot has confidently told you?

sources.claim: Large language models predict the next token based on patterns learned from training text

blocks.narration: AI chatbots do not look anything up. They predict the next word, over and over, faster than you can read it.
blocks.visual: The User at the Desk at night, blue Laptop light on her face as she hits enter

A rapid stream of glowing Tiles pouring out across the Desk

blocks.narration: They were trained on an ocean of text, learning which words tend to follow which. That makes them sound fluent.
blocks.visual: The endless Library of glowing bookshelves stretching up into blue mist

blocks.narration: But sounding right and being right are not the same thing. So sometimes they invent facts, with total confidence.
blocks.visual: One glowing Tile in the stream flickering from blue to red

shots.visual: One glowing Tile in the stream flickering from blue to red
The User frowning at the Laptop, one eyebrow raised in doubt

blocks.narration: Give it context: who you are, what you need, and the exact format you want back. Answers improve fast.

blocks.narration: For facts, ask for sources, then check them yourself. Remember, it is not looking anything up. It is predicting the next word.
